Claims (29)
-----------

What is claimed is:

1. A compound of Formula (III):

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00144](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/b3/60/4d/7274f106527a89/US09439968-20160913-C00144.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/b3/60/4d/7274f106527a89/US09439968-20160913-C00144.png)

 

or a salt thereof, wherein:

each L is, independently, branched or unbranched C1-6 alkylene, wherein L is optionally substituted with one or more fluorine radicals;

each R is, independently, hydrogen or —CH2CH2C(═O)ORB;

each RB is, independently, C10-14 alkyl, wherein RB is optionally substituted with one or more fluorine radicals;

each R1 is, independently, fluoro or C1-6 alkyl optionally substituted with one or more fluorine radicals;

j is 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4; and

p is 1 or 2;

provided that at least three R groups are —CH2CH2C(═O)ORB.

2. The compound of claim 1, wherein L is unbranched C1-6 alkylene.

3. The compound of claim 1, wherein L is methylene, ethylene, or propylene.

4. The compound of claim 1, wherein the compound is of the Formula (III-a):

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00145](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/9c/6d/ef/0cd0d6dd32aefa/US09439968-20160913-C00145.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/9c/6d/ef/0cd0d6dd32aefa/US09439968-20160913-C00145.png)

 

or a salt thereof, wherein each w is, independently, 1, 2, or 3.

5. The compound of claim 1, wherein p is 1.

6. The compound of claim 1, wherein p is 2.

7. The compound of claim 4, wherein the compound is of the formula:

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00146](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/3d/91/39/72faf5c9e52371/US09439968-20160913-C00146.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/3d/91/39/72faf5c9e52371/US09439968-20160913-C00146.png)

 

or a salt thereof.

8. The compound of claim 4, wherein w is 1.

9. The compound of claim 4, wherein w is 2.

10. The compound of claim 4, wherein w is 3.

11. The compound of claim 1, wherein the compound is of the formula:

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00147](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/be/30/04/0a9b5fb56f2a26/US09439968-20160913-C00147.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/be/30/04/0a9b5fb56f2a26/US09439968-20160913-C00147.png)

 

or a salt thereof.

12. The compound of claim 1, wherein all R groups are —CH2CH2C(═O)ORB.

13. The compound of claim 1, wherein all RB groups are the same.

14. The compound of claim 1, wherein RB is C10 alkyl, C11 alkyl, C12 alkyl, C13 alkyl, or C14 alkyl.

15. The compound of claim 1, wherein the compound is selected from the group consisting of:

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00148](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/1e/ed/c9/a1946948c30744/US09439968-20160913-C00148.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/1e/ed/c9/a1946948c30744/US09439968-20160913-C00148.png)

 

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00149](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/0b/0a/e7/03cf0bae95b307/US09439968-20160913-C00149.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/0b/0a/e7/03cf0bae95b307/US09439968-20160913-C00149.png)

 

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00150](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/af/88/f5/d9dfe74e662ec4/US09439968-20160913-C00150.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/af/88/f5/d9dfe74e662ec4/US09439968-20160913-C00150.png)

 

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00151](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/a1/70/80/0d171065d0fabd/US09439968-20160913-C00151.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/a1/70/80/0d171065d0fabd/US09439968-20160913-C00151.png)

 

[![Figure US09439968-20160913-C00152](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/0a/68/47/7a3d835a154952/US09439968-20160913-C00152.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/0a/68/47/7a3d835a154952/US09439968-20160913-C00152.png)

 

and salts thereof.

16. A nanoparticle comprising a compound of claim 1 and one or more agents to be delivered.

17. The nanoparticle of claim 16, wherein at least one of the one or more agents is a polynucleotide, drug, protein, peptide, small molecule, or gas.

18. A composition comprising one or more compounds of claim 1, and an excipient.

19. The composition of claim 18, wherein the composition further comprises an agent.

20. A method of administering an agent, the method comprising:

administering to a subject in need thereof a therapeutically effective amount of a composition comprising a compound of claim 1 and an agent to be delivered.

21. The nanoparticle of claim 16, wherein at least one of the one or more agents is DNA or RNA.

22. The composition of claim 19, wherein the agent is a small molecule or drug.

23. The composition of claim 19, wherein the agent is a protein or peptide.

24. The composition of claim 19, wherein the agent is a polynucleotide.

25. The composition of claim 19, wherein the agent is DNA.

26. The composition of claim 19, wherein the agent is RNA.

27. The composition of claim 19, wherein the agent is siRNA, shRNA, mRNA, dsRNA, miRNA, or antisense RNA.

28. The method of claim 20, wherein the agent is a small molecule, drug, protein, peptide, or polynucleotide.

29. The method of claim 20, wherein the agent is DNA or RNA.
